items.name: The Heart of Texas Winter 2027
items.information: Speedcubing returns to Waco for the first time in nearly a year! ### You may register for any combination of up to 5 events. See the [Event Registration Limit tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TheHeartofTexasWinter2027#84260-event-registration-limit) for more information. This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTA5ODQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d90b474725899b23c9c5d15d90dc03063159a03c/southernCubing.png)
